$comment: The source of sf-checkbox's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/checkbox (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

help.summary: The explanation behind a «?» button (sf-help-mark) after the label text; a press on the button opens it and never changes the control. The help slot takes an sf-help-mark of the page's own.

position.summary: Logical placement of the indicator relative to its text.

value.summary: What a checked box submits; without it, "on", as a native checkbox (standard 1.3.8 §17.1 item 2).

invalid.summary: The shown invalid state: the error look and aria-invalid on the native input.

indeterminate.summary: Mixed visual state for a checkbox that summarizes related options.

change.summary: The checked state changed; the native event bubbles from the inner checkbox, which is its target. It carries no detail.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16): the build does not compile template.html yet, so a second copy of the markup would only drift from the one that draws.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-checkbox for the shim (stands/18-aliases-ci/alias.mjs, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), split / detail-adds (a detail adapter, refused by the shim), attribute-and-property, method, property, manifest-only (the DOM name does not change), host-attribute (no shim), retired.

rows.note: stays a host attribute, read by the base (§3.1, §4.8); no shim
error is a dated alias of invalid; the shim maps the attribute and the property
rows.summary: Legacy name of invalid: a dated alias until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json, standard 1.3.8 §17.2).

x-summary: A native checkbox with a label, Framework presentation and checked, indeterminate and disabled states kept in step between the host attributes and the inner input.
x-renamed: settings.aria-label: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)
x-decisions: a11y-role: checkbox, the native input's own role; the name comes from the label, the label slot, then the host's aria-label (§4.8).
key-effects: Space is toggle:checked (the native checkbox), Tab reach; probe.json drives Space (gate 16).
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; no template.html until the build compiles one (a copy nothing draws would drift).
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json (the checked reference) plus off, indeterminate, description and help, end position, invalid, disabled and size 2.

css-variables: the six public variables of src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json plus one per recolourable state, checked and invalid (§6); the state rules read them with the role token as fallback.

set-boolean-state-attribute is not an action: it is the element's own helper for checked/indeterminate/disabled attributes, never a request a rule makes; the method stays, the interface drops it (§4.4).
checked is not optional: the checkbox has no inherited state, so absent and false are one state and checked="false" is never written.
help is the explanation (a string), drawn as sf-help-mark after the label text (1.2.0, W1); until 1.2.0 it was an icon name drawn as a decorative <sf-icon>.
error -> invalid: §17.2 makes invalid the shown state and error its dated alias (aliases.json, until 2026-12-01); the class .error stays the look.
value defaults to "on": a checked box without value submits "on", as a native checkbox (§17.1 item 2; it submitted "" before).
form: the host is the form control through ElementInternals; the inner checkbox carries no name (§17.1 item 6); validity is custom-error only.
version 1.1.0: a renamed member behind a dated alias is a minor (§4.10, §16.20).

version 1.1.2: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.
version 1.1.3: the first-paint sheet list names the utility sheets its templates draw with (core.runtime 1.0.7 asks for them before the element draws: the style gate).

version 1.1.5: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.2.0 (2026-11-11; was a patch 1.1.7 on the branch, never released): the name is the label alone, the description is the description (docs pre-check 2026-11-10 CH-03, as sf-switch 1.3.1): the input is named by the label row (aria-labelledby) and described by the description (aria-describedby) through src/component/checkable-text-helper.js, for the element, its slots (a slotted description is held in a span with an id) and the class markup alike; an author's aria-label or aria-labelledby wins, ids come from the instance path. Nothing is drawn differently. Also: the help setting is the explanation, not an icon name (audit 2026-11-11, W1): it draws an sf-help-mark after the label text (size 1/3 beside sizes 1/2 and 1, 1/2 beside size 2; its button named «Подробнее: <label>», word runtime.help), the help slot keeps taking content of its own; it was a decorative aria-hidden icon inside the <label>, so no help existed and a press on it toggled the control. A press that comes from the help (sf-help-mark or what the help slot holds) cancels the label's activation (keepHelpOutOfLabel in src/component/checkable-text-helper.js), the mark stands above the native control's hit area, and pressing it paints no pressed box. The input is named by the label text alone (a slotted label is held in a span), so the help button's name is not part of it; the <label> names its input by `for` (an instance-path id). position="end" puts the box at the end of the row, as the docs promise (the text column takes the rest of the row; it stood right after the text, 403 px from the row end at 1440; W4). Examples: the help example has an explanation. A minor, not a patch (§4.10): the help setting changes meaning, from an icon name to the explanation text; a page that passed an icon name shows the name as text (journal behaviour-choice-help-text, until 2027-01-01). Also in 1.2.0 (owner remarks 2026-11-11, C59): the help mark is the <label>'s sibling, not inside it: with help the element draws a row (.sf-checkable-row) that holds the <label> and the mark after it, --sf-space-1/4 after the label, in a box one label line tall at the row's top, so it is centred on the first line; the label gives way first and the mark never wraps alone. Pressing «?» presses no control: the label never becomes :active and the value stays. The hit area is the box and its text: the element's own <label> hugs its content (inline-size: fit-content; max-inline-size: 100%), so a press on the empty rest of the row does nothing; position="end" keeps the full row (the box is at the row's end, W4). Class markup inside list rows, menus, choice lists and table rows (C49 rows) is not the element's own label and keeps its full width (component.checkbox 1.2.0). The name and the description are unchanged. C63 (owner 2026-11-11, audit W5, W6, W9), in the same release: W5, a control with text is a row of its step, (control height - line) / 2 above and below on its own <label>, no gap of its own: 40 at size 1, 60 with a description line, 32 in compact, and under a coarse pointer the step is the touch target max(step, --sf-d1) as the C49 rows; a bare box (no label, no description) stays the box. W6, the label is regular in all three (checkbox and radio drew medium). W9, one shared base: src/smart/helpers/checkable-row.js and checkable-row.css (module.smart-helpers 1.5.0) draw the text column with its help slot, the help mark, the row (.sf-checkable-row) and hold the row's padding, the hit area, the help size and place for the three; the name and description binding is src/component/checkable-text-helper.js for all three (sf-switch had its own copy). The control's <label> carries .sf-checkable, .sf-checkable--size-<size> and, with text, .sf-checkable--text. Journal behaviour-choice-row-step.

version 1.2.0, also (2026-11-12, fix/choice-controls-w): with help and text, the «?» stands right after the name (C59, intent acceptance of the group build 2026-11-12): beside the name's line when the description is longer than the name, and with position="end" between the name and the free space, the box at the row's end. The shared row (module.smart-helpers 1.6.0, checkable-row.css) is a grid there; the <label> and its text column hand their parts to it (display: contents) and the label's ::before keeps the hit area the control and its text (the whole row for position end). The markup, the name, the description and the row heights are unchanged; the «?» stays outside the label.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-checkbox when the interface needs the checkbox behavior.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component

getInputElement.summary: Returns the inner native checkbox input, or null before render.

isChecked.summary: Return the current native checked state.

setChecked.summary: Sets the checked state on the host attribute and the inner input through setState(). Returns the element.

setIndeterminate.summary: Sets the indeterminate state on the host attribute and the inner input through setState(). Returns the element.

setDisabled.summary: Sets the disabled state on the host attribute and the inner input through setState(). Returns the element.

setBooleanStateAttribute.summary: Adds the named host attribute as an empty attribute when value is truthy, removes it otherwise.

setState.summary: Applies checked, indeterminate and disabled to both the host attribute and the inner input; any other keys go to the base setState as host attributes. Returns the element.

onChange.summary: Adds a listener for change on the host. Returns the element.

onFocus.summary: Adds a listener for focusin on the host. Returns the element.

onBlur.summary: Adds a listener for focusout on the host. Returns the element.

aria-label.description: Accessible name for a checkbox rendered without a visible label.
